svg.title: 75 kiloohm sensor input divider using the carrier R31 pulldown
svg.desc: X070 remains connected to the PLC. A new 75 kiloohm resistor connects X070 to J20 pin 1. Existing carrier R31, 10 kiloohms, connects this node to common ground at J20 pin 3. Existing R10, 100 ohms, connects the node to MCU PA9. Remove the external 15 kiloohm resistor. J20 pin 2 is unused.
svg.text: One added resistor; the carrier provides the lower divider resistor.
Do not add a second one
REMOVE the external 15 kΩ resistor. J20 pin 2 is unused.
*Nominal calculation, 0.27–0.28 mA. Signal range assumed: 21.6–26.4 V. Verify on the connected carrier.
Simplified circuit; other carrier parts omitted. LED behavior requires the corrected active-LOW firmware.
